digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira and adapters/jira_datacenter — Cloud <-> DC reconciler parity
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) have asymmetric test coverage: Cloud has byte-for-byte characterization and ADF depth tests; DC has pagination and rate-limiting tests, creating bidirectional gaps
DC adapter's create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, and probe branches lack value-level pins; contract test only asserts shape, not correctness of values
DC comment and description convergence behavior has never been tested across multiple passes, and the comment character ceiling's origin is undocumented in source
A ticket-type map is duplicated within adapters/ without enforcement that only one canonical copy exists, creating risk of divergence between Cloud and DC paths
Five enumerated tests lack assertions matching their docstring contracts and cannot fail on value changes, reducing confidence in DC adapter defect-freedom
